column3: All segment counts tend to infinity for the specified propagator; a product-formula route needs a uniform accumulated error estimate, not convergence on one oscillator. Propagator/domain hypotheses and successor proof body remain unchecked.

For every smooth covariant finite-rank projector family with fermionic symmetry in dimension three: FMP Theorem 3 gives iff vanishing of four face indices. Section 6.3 extends frames through vertices, edges, faces and interior; Appendix A is the smoothness dependency. Already reported in the 2015 primary body; arXiv v2 is dated 12 Jan 2016. No new construction eligible.

The requested conceptual explanation concerns the full limiting covariance deformation, not computing one tensor-product example. Need actual covariance formula and model scaling before a cumulant/intertwiner mechanism can be assessed.

Uniform determination for every local field and u>1 requires reconstructing nonabelian ramification quotients from hyperfield data. Abelian local class field theory alone does not meet scope; primary comparison theorem and current successors not reviewed.

Existence of a finitely presented counterexample to either of two unstated dichotomies. A group presentation is a small potential certificate, but the antecedents are absent from the literal statement. Recover both primary dichotomies before testing examples; no wording repair counted.

Universal action-dimension lower bound in every degree with nonzero L2 Betti number. A low-dimensional group example checks only an instance. General bridge from L2 homology to proper manifold actions is missing; no short full-scope mechanism.

A positive uniform lower ratio over cycles (including dependence on d,N) is the substantive question; the literal nonnegative lower bound zero is not a discovery. Torsion/integrality-gap constructions would need mass control in Euclidean fillings. Source quantifiers and admissible chains need recovery.

All smooth geometrically irreducible projective rational curves of genus at least two, not one explicitly solvable curve. Finiteness is supplied; a terminating uniform effective height bound is the missing mechanism. No small certificate for the general determination problem.

Full exterior nonlinear stability of both Schwarzschild and Kerr requires precise perturbation spaces and parameter ranges. Linear mode stability or a small-spin theorem cannot clear all Kerr. Large PDE bootstrap and current successor bodies required; no bounded full-scope route.

Compute persistence exponents for every integration order d>=2. Self-similarity gives scaling but not the killed-process spectral exponent; the d=1 value cannot be extrapolated. Needs nonselfadjoint spectral analysis, no finite certificate identified.

Nondegeneracy of the entire constructed CMC family means trivial Jacobi kernel modulo the source symmetries. The family and permitted deformations are unspecified in the literal question; no eigenvalue calculation on a chosen sphere meets scope.

Universal variance extremality at fixed statistical dimension across cones. Candidate approach compares intrinsic-volume second moments with circular cones, but dimension and admissible cones must be fixed from primary body. No verified moment inequality or counterexample yet.

Minimum random projection dimension for arbitrary linearly separated sets and every failure tolerance. Must specify projection distribution and margin/geometry; separation alone supplies no nontrivial universal reduction. Gaussian-width sufficient bounds would not establish the requested optimum.

Construct enough cycles for all repeated Frobenius-eigenvalue cases of the specified Shimura variety. A cycle in one rank does not prove Tate surjectivity. Requires the full automorphic/isotypic setup and a new cycle-generation mechanism, no small full-scope certificate.

Worst VaR over all couplings of arbitrary prescribed marginals at a given alpha. Discrete LP gives only instances; quantile duality may reformulate but does not produce an analytic universal optimum certificate. No bounded uniform mechanism identified.

Analytical joint-mixability decision for arbitrary tuples of distribution functions. Equal means or bounded-support inequalities are only necessary in general. Infinite-dimensional coupling feasibility remains, not a small exact witness for all inputs.

NP certificates for each remaining Thurston geometry require polynomial bit-size triangulation certificates and verified completeness, beyond normal-surface existence. Primary body lists H2xR, PSL2R and H3 as remaining; no short certificate-size proof assessed.

Same positive-weight combinatorial surface model as primary report lines 487-510. It explicitly reports an O(n^2 log n) algorithm and a cut-locus proof mechanism: shortest essential based loops concatenate shortest paths and cross the cut locus once. Original dependency proof not downloaded/read; retirement is source-reported algorithm evidence, not an independently verified implementation or novelty clearance.

Primary report lines 523-534 reports a general algorithm via a finite region of the universal cover and cites Colin de Verdiere-Erickson 2010. Simple-path algorithms have restrictions and are not the full bridge. Full general dependency proof not read; retire at source-reported result level only.

Explicit rational local cocycles for all Pontryagin degrees, beyond existence. Finite enumeration of links cannot establish the cocycle equations uniformly; need explicit local cochain construction and normalization. No full-scope bounded formula identified.

Direct links between Nichols algebras/Weyl groupoids and cluster algebras is a research programme without a precise universal endpoint in the literal statement. A rank-two coincidence is an example, not a resolution. Need primary hypotheses and an exact theorem before investment.

Find conditions on two-dimensional fans ensuring exactly one positive eigenvalue. Simply requiring the spectral conclusion restates the goal; testing a matrix is only an instance. Need the primary Laplacian weights/balancing assumptions and noncircular sufficient geometric criterion.

Relation of Stanley projective dimension to finite-lattice invariants lacks an exact claimed equality or extremal bound here. Existing homological inequalities are potential subsumers; primary definitions and successor bodies absent. No theorem formulated from metadata.

Every admissible pair (P,c), not an arbitrary poset chosen for an easy counterexample. A closure-operator/Quillen-fiber contraction is the natural short route, but pseudo-join monotonicity and admissibility require the original definitions. Not executed without them.

All eligible G,e and all k require a formula for largest cohomology-representative weight. Subdivision suspension periodicity alone controls degree, not representative support weight. Need the source weight convention and equivalence relation before a transfer recurrence is meaningful.

Classify all good dual graphs and realize their configurations on Enriques surfaces. A lattice embedding alone does not prove surface realization. Requires both combinatorial completeness and geometry; no bounded full classification mechanism.

Physically correct polygonization for bent beams is a continuum model-selection and numerical-analysis programme. One computed pattern does not establish physical correctness. Nonconvex micro-rotation preconditioning remains the explicit analytical obstacle.

All coefficients in the two indefinite-orthogonal convergent integrals, with p,q and indices varying. Evaluate basis test bodies then invert a finite system is a potential mechanism, but normalization, basis, convergence and rank dependencies are absent from the literal statement.

Operations neither pointwise nor associative are not a precise class or endpoint in the literal question. Cannot infer a distributive identity from the omitted preceding results. Need primary definitions; an arbitrary operation/example would not resolve scope.

Absolute c independent of n for every convex family, selecting at most 2n members and obtaining diameter O(sqrt(n)). John decomposition gives a plausible sparsification route but controlling selected intersection diameter at the stated factor is the entire missing bound. No parameter-only check counts.

Necessary and sufficient measure conditions for every integer 1<=k<=n and every finite Borel sphere measure. Even-case or k=n solutions do not cover arbitrary measures and all k. Nonlinear convex-geometric existence and uniqueness/normalization hypotheses need successor review.

Every remaining Schatten p, both real and complex, with dimension-uniform thin-shell control. Need the primary range already settled and exact normalization. Singular-value integrals are a route but finite-n computations do not certify uniform variance.

Smallest entropy ideal containing nonapproximable operators requires the ordering and ideal norm conventions. One nonapproximable operator in an entropy class only gives an upper inclusion witness. Minimality across all competing ideals is not supplied.

Both extrema of the second Neumann eigenfunction for every convex domain, with multiplicity and dimension conventions to recover. Maximum principle alone does not rule out interior extrema for nonzero eigenvalue. Small-domain numerics do not resolve the full hot-spots conjecture.

Fundamental estimation limit plus an adaptive achieving procedure over the intended high-dimensional Tobit-I model. Minimax rates depend on censoring, sparsity, design and loss; no such class is specified here. A chosen Gaussian instance cannot settle scope.

Exact ordinary resurgences for both fixed Klein and Wiman configurations. Symbolic-power containment can yield witnesses but all-r upper control is essential. Primary problem read; search surfaced a successor about negative curves and asymptotic resurgence, but its proof body not read, so neither ordinary/asymptotic identification nor clearance claimed.

Topological complexity for every real projective dimension. Its relation to immersion dimension leaves exceptional/global computation; isolated n calculations are already instances. No full-function certificate or new mechanism identified.

Invariant TC of the specified reflection action for all dimensions; malformed literal control characters retained. Fixed-point and quotient lower bounds are a plausible short route but exact convention (reduced/unreduced) and equivariant path-space definition need primary recovery. No value asserted from a notation repair.

Both transition fields throughout the hysteretic magnetic-wall model. A critical-point calculation requires material parameters, energy functional and stability branch definition. Equating two energies need not detect either hysteretic loss of stability.

Entropy monotonicity for the full semi-Lagrangian DG scheme, not only piecewise constants. Primary explicitly calls proof missing and separately mentions positivity limiters. Jensen works for a positive Markov projection; high-order L2 projection need not be positive, so this shortcut is not a general proof. No negative-value or wording witness counted.

Algebraic-value points of the intended transcendental Mahler function, not arbitrary transcendental functions. Need its functional system, singular locus and algebraicity hypotheses. A lifting theorem may subsume the task; primary and closest successor proofs not reviewed.

Exact absolute-continuity parameter set for all lambda in (0,1). Almost-everywhere results or reciprocal-Pisot singular cases leave exceptional parameters. No finite algebraic test or full-set mechanism identified; malformed introductory escapes retained.

Literal asymptotic equality is already primary report Theorem 1, not an open conjecture. Alon author-hosted full paper Theorem 1.1 and Section 2 supply the proof: random graph for low-automorphism induced subgraphs plus a small structured part for the highly symmetric remainder. This is the exact full asymptotic endpoint, no new credit.

Every fixed H and every n>=chi(H)|H| at the sharp stated threshold, not merely sufficiently large n or complete H. Path embedding via expansion is plausible but threshold control is the missing general bridge. Primary/successor exact ranges not cleared.

Asymptotic minimum F2 vector dimension for all nonzero simple-cycle sums on K_n,n. Row/column gauge normalization helps encode constraints, but arbitrary cycles create global dependencies. Small-n exhaustive search cannot certify the asymptotic optimum; no cheap matching bounds identified.

Structure of every extremizer with e>n^2/4, all k>=3 and sufficiently large n. Need precise meaning of almost complete and C_(2k+1)-edge, and which e-regimes are intended. A dense example or a stability theorem would not establish exact block structure uniformly.

Full classification over hyperbolic even lattices for the square-two reflection group. Finite rank searches need a proven global rank/discriminant bound and completeness; neither provided. No bounded classification certificate route.

Decide soliton existence for arbitrary homogeneous spaces. Lie-algebra moment-map criteria could handle restricted reductive presentations but do not supply a short effective all-input criterion here. Needs full homogeneous and metric conventions; no general small certificate.

Every prescribed smooth F on a compact balanced manifold, preserving balancedness while prescribing the exact volume. Naive conformal scaling achieves volume but generally destroys d(omega^(n-1))=0. In complex dimension one constant nonzero F works, so a single dimension is not a counterexample or solution; source dimension/cohomological constraints and successor body required.

All hyperspecial double cosets in every split p-adic group. Cartan decomposition plus root-subgroup representatives suggests an existing standard mechanism, but explicit residue representatives, stabilizers and multiplicities depend on the root datum. Need the actual requested algorithm and prior proof bodies before classifying routine adaptation.
